title: Schema, rules and seed index
shortVerdict: CAR workspace and schema were created as a Norway-first registry control layer with candidate vs verified separation.
strongestSource: Local seed files including Brreg validated circular actors, sirkulaer-selskaper-norge, Exa actor registry and R12 actor outputs
weakestPoint: This batch creates registry scaffolding and first seed rows; it does not complete category research or live source refresh.
sourceClass: A/B local seed basis with explicit C gaps
gapType: Type A for local consolidation; Type B for actor verification; Type C for non-public/member data
ikkeSi: Do not call CAR complete after setup.
Do not treat candidate rows as verified.
Do not infer production volume from registry incorporation or funding.

title: Consolidated local seeds into candidate registry
shortVerdict: A first candidate registry was seeded from existing local source files while preserving unverified/candidate status.
strongestSource: Existing local seed files and R12 actor notes
weakestPoint: Not every local actor mention has been deeply deduped or Brreg validated; later CAR batches must expand and verify by category.
sourceClass: B with A anchors where local Brreg note exists
gapType: Type A for dedupe/source follow-up; Type B for actor checks
ikkeSi: Do not use candidate CSV as complete register.
Do not call Nordic context rows Norway coverage.
Do not use combined rows like Greve Biogass/Lindum in verified export.

title: Initial Brreg-backed verified export
shortVerdict: A conservative verified CSV was created only from rows with existing Brreg-backed org-number evidence in the local seed note.
weakestPoint: Verified means identity/register row is sourced; circular impact, volume and founder data remain separate PCQ or actor-gate tasks.
sourceClass: A for registry identity, B/C for impact fields not included
gapType: Type A for further source extraction; Type B for actor data
ikkeSi: Do not treat verified identity as verified impact.
Do not infer circular mechanism solely from NACE.
Do not add founders/key people without primary source.
